designationHistory.indexText: Great Bay National Wildlife Refuge About Us Contact Us Visit Us Activities Trails Rules & Policies Events News Species Map About Us Established in 1992, Great Bay National Wildlife Refuge is located along the eastern shore of New Hampshire's Great Bay in the town of Newington.
